entities.summary: Conchita Carpio-Morales is a Filipino lawyer and jurist who served at the ombudsman of the Philippines serving from 2011 to 2018. Prior to this, she was an associate justice of the Supreme Court of the Philippines from 2002 to 2011. Across her career, she secured appointments from five Philippine presidents: Ferdinand Marcos, Corazon Aquino, Fidel Ramos, Gloria Macapagal Arroyo, and Benigno Aquino III.
